feature: History backend transitions preserve consent and current records

scenarios.name: Failed opt-out never resumes an old semantic backend
scenarios.given: an optional backend is indexed and storage prevents switching it off
scenarios.when: storage recovers before a later archive sync retries the intended fallback
scenarios.then: exact-word search remains available but semantic results and Ask dispatch stay blocked until the fallback is installed; no old optional backend resumes

scenarios.name: A saved conversation retries the intended backend
scenarios.given: a backend transition failed while derived storage was unavailable
scenarios.when: storage returns and the current conversation is saved
scenarios.then: the intended backend is installed and current records are indexed without reverting to the old backend

scenarios.name: Late old searches cannot restore replaced or deleted history
scenarios.given: a search is suspended in an old backend
scenarios.when: the backend changes and the current archive replaces the old conversation
scenarios.then: the current conversation is indexed and shown by the new backend and the old completion restores neither text nor results

scenarios.name: Backend changes revoke old answers and citations
scenarios.given: Ask is streaming an answer from the previous backend's retrieved excerpts
scenarios.when: the backend and current archive change before the old provider completes
scenarios.then: the old answer and citations clear immediately and its late output cannot replace a new answer grounded in current records

scenarios.name: Saved vectors refresh the current semantic query
scenarios.given: a nonlexical History search is active and a new or edited conversation is waiting to finish embedding
scenarios.when: the save publishes its new vectors without another keystroke
scenarios.then: the current search reruns and shows the saved conversation and current snippet

scenarios.name: A superseded save cannot refresh a newer backend epoch
scenarios.given: a save is awaiting its previous backend
scenarios.when: the backend and current conversation change before the old save returns
scenarios.then: the old completion cannot change the current query results or search generation

scenarios.name: Clear revokes an older save batch hidden behind queued work
scenarios.given: an older multi-record save batch is suspended and a newer maintenance wrapper is queued behind it
scenarios.when: History is cleared before the older inference finishes
scenarios.then: neither unvisited old records nor stale refresh callbacks return after clear
